== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[R5-A2 (Arfive-Aytoo) (Japanese)|R5-A2 (Arfive-Aytoo)]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/160005377/sy_FLKle10ij2NI3d40MBg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 160005377.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>8695bfe36a8595af48d68b9775269caf984bd782c53868ef2ddd9a582523af82</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
